lifecycle_reproduction.script_source:
import json
import sqlite3
import time
from unittest import mock
from tools.testqueue.test_worker import WorkerFixture

case = WorkerFixture()
case.setUp()
try:
    actual_update = case.worker.store.update
    observed = {}
    def fail_after_healthy_start(job, attempt, state, data):
        if state == "RUNNING" and data.get("launch") == "CREATED_OWNED":
            process = case.worker.active[attempt]
            started = case.worker.root / "attempts" / attempt / "started.json"
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 8
            while not started.exists() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
                time.sleep(0.01)
            assert started.exists(), "isolated fake adapter did not start"
            assert process.alive(), "isolated owned process already exited"
            observed.update(attempt=attempt, pid=process.pid, started=json.loads(started.read_text()))
            raise sqlite3.OperationalError("isolated injected post-start journal failure")
        return actual_update(job, attempt, state, data)
    with mock.patch.object(case.worker.store, "update", side_effect=fail_after_healthy_start):
        accepted = case._submit("long-poststart-storage", headless=True)
        result = case._finish(accepted["job"])
    assert observed, "fault was not injected"
    assert result["state"] == "FINISHED"
    assert result["outcome"] == "INFRA_FAILED"
    assert result["cleanup"] == "CONFIRMED"
    assert "isolated injected post-start journal failure" in result["error"]
    assert not (case.worker.root / "attempts" / observed["attempt"] / "ended.json").exists()
    print(json.dumps({"owned_process_alive_at_injection": True, "state": result["state"],
                      "outcome": result["outcome"], "cleanup": result["cleanup"],
                      "fake_workload_completed_normally": False, "error": result["error"]}))
finally:
    case.doCleanups()
